title: Market Surf Report

conditions.headline: Tech paddles back out after two choppy sessions
conditions.summary: Nasdaq futures lead a rebound on CoreWeave's strong outlook and a chip-stock bounce. Hot October inflation and a likely December Fed hike keep a crosswind on the water.

sections.title: Futures & Overnight
items: S&P 500 futures are up about 0.8% and Nasdaq-100 futures about 1.8% in early, thin trading; sources disagree on size, but all point higher.
Dow futures are up about 0.1%; Russell 2000 futures and the VIX were not available in our sources.
Tuesday's close: S&P 500 -0.38% at 7,520.93, Nasdaq Composite -0.74%, Dow -0.30% at 52,231.89.
The bond market is closed for Veterans Day; the 10-year yield sits near 5.0% after rising on hot CPI.
WTI crude is near $86.69 (+0.8%), Brent near $92.6; gold is about $4,063 (-0.8%); bitcoin about $73,950 (-0.3%).
Asia: mostly higher, led by tech; Nikkei and Kospi up, Hang Seng down slightly.
Europe: index futures point to a higher open.

sections.title: Macro & Economic Calendar
items: October CPI rose 0.4% vs. 0.3% expected; core rose 0.3% vs. 0.2%.
Futures pricing shows roughly an 86-90% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike in December, with some odds of 50 bp.
Fed Governor Waller said a larger December hike should be considered.
Today's US calendar is light: stocks open, bond market closed for Veterans Day.
Oil is swinging on talk of an end to the US-Iran conflict and a report of a tanker hitting a mine near Hormuz.

sections.title: Earnings
items: CoreWeave: Q3 revenue $3.66B (+168%), ahead of estimates; 2026 revenue outlook raised to $13.0-13.3B. Stock up about 13% pre-market.
Rigetti Computing: revenue $1.4M vs. $3.5M expected; shares fell about 9% after hours.
Lightwave Logic: volume production pushed to 2028; shares fell about 28% after hours.
Mercury Systems beat on revenue and adjusted EPS and raised its outlook; Sonos also beat.
Before the open: CGI. After today's close: Corteva, Franco-Nevada and Tetra Tech. Thursday after the close: Cisco and Applied Materials.

sections.title: Stocks in the News
items: CRWV (CoreWeave): about +13% — strong revenue and raised 2026 outlook.
NVDA (Nvidia): about +3% — rebounding after a two-day 9.5% drop tied to a board inquiry into the CEO.
INTC (Intel): about +5% — joining a broad chip-stock bounce.
MU (Micron): about +1.5% — chip rebound; tied in headlines to Anthropic's IPO.
RGTI (Rigetti Computing): about -9% after hours — revenue miss.
LWLG (Lightwave Logic): about -28% after hours — production timeline delayed to 2028.

sections.title: Business News
items: Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow, marketing shares at $70-$78 at a valuation near $1.4 trillion.
TSMC said October revenue rose about 60% from a year ago.
OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly topped $10 billion for the first time.
Strategy (the bitcoin holder) could be dropped from MSCI indexes; MSCI's final list is due after today's close.
GE Vernova fell Tuesday after SoftBank revised its US data-center power plans.

sections.title: What to Watch Today
items: 8:30 AM CT open: does the tech rebound hold after the hot CPI print?
Chip stocks: Nvidia's bounce after its two-day slide.
After the close: Corteva and Franco-Nevada earnings, plus MSCI's decision list affecting Strategy.

Cowabunga! This is Surf Daddy, your local Kahuna, live from Surfside USA to all you Trade Wind surfers from the Gulf Coast to the North Shore. It's Wednesday, November eleventh, twenty twenty-six, and this is your Market Surf Report. Happy Veterans Day to everyone who served. My co-anchor Gus the wonder dog is on the deck with his paws up on the rail, watching the sets roll in. Gus, give the Dawn Patrol a good morning hello! [BARK]

Let's check the swell. After two choppy sessions, the futures are paddling back out. In early and thin trading, S and P 500 futures are up about eight tenths of a percent, Nasdaq 100 futures are up close to two percent, and Dow futures are up about a tenth of a percent. Asia was mostly green, led by tech, and Europe is set to open higher.

The bond market is closed today for Veterans Day, so the ten-year Treasury yield sits near five percent from Tuesday. Crude oil is up almost one percent, near eighty-seven dollars. Gold slipped almost one percent. Bitcoin is flat near seventy-four thousand dollars.

Now the wind and weather. Tuesday's October inflation report ran hot. Headline prices rose four tenths of a percent, a tenth above forecast. Traders now see close to a ninety percent chance the Fed raises rates by a quarter point in December. That's a gnarly crosswind.

On the tide chart, CoreWeave posted revenue up one hundred sixty-eight percent and raised its outlook. The stock is up around thirteen percent before the bell. Now that's a clean barrel. That calls for a treat, Gus! Here you go, buddy! [SNACK]

Rigetti Computing missed on revenue and fell about nine percent after hours. That's a wipeout. After today's close, we hear from Corteva, Franco-Nevada and Tetra Tech.

In the lineup, Nvidia is bouncing about three percent after a two-day slide tied to its board looking into the chief executive. Intel is up about five percent, and Micron is up about one and a half percent.

Beach talk. Anthropic launched its I P O roadshow, marketing shares between seventy and seventy-eight dollars at a valuation near one point four trillion dollars. That's no grommet. And oil traders are watching talk of an end to the Iran conflict, plus a tanker hit by a mine near the Strait of Hormuz.

Sets to watch today. Can tech hang ten all day after the hot inflation print? Watch the opening bell at eight thirty A M Central.

Want me to call a wave for you? Type any stock, E T F or futures contract into the Check a Wave box on the page, and Surf Daddy will call it for you.
